observedOfficialCapabilities: The live SD results app exposes current election CSV/media/export pages and ResultsAjax service methods.
The WSDL exposes GetMapDataArchive, GetVoterTurnoutArchive, and GetProvisionalDataArchive methods that require an integer ElectionID.
The public pages inspected in this pass defaulted to the 2026 Primary Election; no scriptable 2024 General Election archive ElectionID or static canvass PDF URL was confirmed.
officialSourceProbe.blocker: Obtain the official SD SOS canvass PDF/static export, specifically the official 2024 General Election Canvass and Certificate PDF/static export URL or the electionresults.sd.gov archive ElectionID for November 5, 2024, before promoting SD to completed official-native coverage.

displayCaveats: County result and review rows are caveated secondary staging coverage until the official SD SOS canvass/export is retained.
Review rows are county-level President-versus-at-large-U.S.-House comparisons, not precinct-level scatter plots.
Turnout uses EAC jurisdiction fallback rows until state-native South Dakota turnout/registration denominator rows are collected.
Historical baselines are contextual secondary county tables for 2012, 2016, and 2020.
County geometry is loaded; precinct geometry/crosswalks and normalized audit/CVR/recount/incident/correction/litigation rows are not loaded.
